references.observation: Oblique river elevation reveals the pointed high central arch, lower side arches, pale square stone courses, fired brick and a marker tower at either end.
Describes a 23 m bridge about 6.3 m wide and 8.3 m tall, with four marker towers and river-stone paving.

mapReview.result: The map shows the village approach roads and Gadar River centerline. No mapped bridge feature in the inspected tiles identifies this structure. The reference coordinate identifies the village. The crossing centerline, heading, and abutment grade remain unresolved.
